## Background

Maanasa is a software engineer with extensive experience in distributed systems, backend cloud architecture, and full-stack web applications.
Holds an M.S. in Computer Science from Northeastern University (GPA 3.9/4.0) and a B.E. in Computer Science from KSIT, VTU.
Prior roles include Kayak (Boston), Amazon (Seattle), Nokia (Raleigh), Adobe (Bengaluru), and Infosys (Mysuru).
